check_box.label: Run the Atmo Magic weather system
check_box.name: atmo_enabled_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: The master switch for the whole system. Off, every subsystem below is inert and the viewer's normal weather, wind and lighting run untouched.

check_box.label: Solve a flowmap of the build's wind
check_box.name: windflow_enabled_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: A per-region fluid solve describing how wind actually moves through geometry, so alleys funnel, lees go calm and rooftops gust. Needs OpenGL 4.3; falls back to a single uniform wind without it.

check_box.label: Carry precipitation around buildings
check_box.name: windflow_advect_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Rain and snow curve with the solved field instead of drifting uniformly.

check_box.label: Carry in-world particles
check_box.name: windflow_particles_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Wind-tagged smoke, dust and leaves funnel down alleys and lift over rooflines instead of drifting on the sim's uniform breeze.

check_box.label: Drive viewer wind, audio and flexi
check_box.name: windflow_viewerwind_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: The wind heard in the headphones and how flexible prims blow follow the local field instead of the region breeze.

check_box.label: Rebuild edits in a local box
check_box.name: windflow_partial_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: A settled edit only re-solves the flow it can change - a little upwind and everything downwind - warm-started from the previous field.

check_box.label: Solve on a worker GL thread
check_box.name: windflow_worker_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Runs the solve and its readback on a dedicated shared-context GL thread so a rebuild never stalls the frame loop. Falls back to the main thread if a shared context cannot be made.

check_box.label: Build shared solid-structure field
check_box.name: worldfield_enabled_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: One region-anchored capture of the build's solid structure that the surface, coverage and future channels read instead of each capturing its own. Builds nothing until a channel needs it.

check_box.label: Render rain with the water shader
check_box.name: rain_shader_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Refraction, environment and specular water look on rain-family particles instead of the plain fullbright path.

check_box.label: Splash and ripple where drops land
check_box.name: atmo_ripples_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Impact splashes and running ripples near the camera while precipitation falls.

check_box.label: Shed collected rain off roof edges
check_box.name: atmo_runoff_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Eaves and overhangs drip into the street below while it is raining.

check_box.label: Render the wet surface material
check_box.name: atmo_wetsurfaces_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Wet floors, rooftops and streets tighten their specular response against rain and hold the roof runoff. Off freezes the look even at full SSAtmoWetStrength.

check_box.label: Pool lying water into puddles
check_box.name: atmo_puddles_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Flat ground collects rain into puddle patches. Off drains the visible puddles - rain keeps hitting and running off, it just stops pooling.

check_box.label: Render accumulated snow material
check_box.name: atmo_snowsurfaces_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Settled snow lifts surfaces toward white and adds drift sparkle. Off freezes the look even at full SSAtmoSnowSurfaceStrength.

check_box.label: Render the snow whiteout fog
check_box.name: atmo_whiteout_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: The local, height-limited volumetric fog that collapses visibility inside the squall and the ground blizzard. Off keeps the storm but never the veil.

check_box.label: Draw and sound lightning
check_box.name: atmo_lightning_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Sheet, fork and ground strikes under storm skies. Stable and breezy weather never strikes regardless.

check_box.label: Play the impact soundscape
check_box.name: atmo_sounds_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Footsteps, landing impacts and the ambient wind audio the Atmo Magic mix drives.
